output.explanation: This request asks me to change data (update list_price for product 5 in marts.dim_products to 0). I can only write read-only SELECT queries against the warehouse, so I can't perform this update. To make the change, someone with write access to the source system or dbt pipeline would need to do it, and note that dim_products is a mart table, so the change may be overwritten on the next dbt run unless it is made in the source data.
